changelog:
- Initial release of the Agent-Era Pricing skill.
- Provides a framework for migrating from traditional seat-based pricing to value-based metrics suitable for human+agent hybrid usage.
- Produces a comprehensive pricing migration plan, including value metric selection, agent-tier packaging, cannibalisation analysis with real customer cohorts, and a phased migration strategy.
- Includes guidelines for designing revenue-protective fences and setting ongoing pricing tripwires.
- Outlines required customer and usage inputs and details quality checks and common anti-patterns to avoid.
summary: Redesign seat-based pricing for the agent era — when one human runs ten agents, per-seat models collapse. Use when agents are eroding seat counts, when asked...
